description: Phi-4 is Microsoft's 14B parameter language model emphasizing exceptional STEM reasoning capabilities. It uses a training methodology focused on high-quality synthetic data and achieves performance competitive with much larger models on reasoning benchmarks.

trainingData.description: Trained primarily on high-quality synthetic data generated by larger models, following the 'Textbooks Are All You Need' philosophy. Emphasis on reasoning chains and step-by-step solutions.

trainingProcedure: Curated high-quality data training with emphasis on synthetic data, reasoning chains, and mathematical problem-solving patterns.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Exceptional STEM reasoning. Competitive with GPT-4-class models on reasoning tasks despite much smaller size.

knownLimitations: Smaller context window compared to competitors (16K)
May struggle with tasks outside STEM domain
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias. Training data curation aims to reduce harmful outputs.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

requirements.deployment: Local deployment or cloud deployment via Azure AI

hardware.14B: GPU recommended, ~28GB VRAM for full precision
